source_policy_decisions.decision: Close the four-display question for the named Osmania main text. State both ktvā orders and separate a grammatical list from continuous literary usage.
At 1.4.72 the edition records the disputed reading and an objection. At 8.3.42 its main sound rule retains the gati requirement. The two facts can be registered simultaneously.
Close the printed location of the separately reported s reading at the sound rule. Do not supply an unchecked manuscript identity, an independent stemma or the editors’ endorsement.
Neither the availability of the earlier reported non-gati policy nor PG42’s default needs a new word or operator credit. An editorial note about evidential support is itself a positive source event.
